title: Sarkari Bus Ka Contract: Bus Khaali Ho Ya Bhari, Owner Ko Paisa Kyun Milta Hai?
description: The OSRTC reel reached 8.7M views and 524k likes because viewers had never heard of this model. Our own angle adds the risks and a state-agnostic framework instead of one state's figures.
text:
HISAAB FACT SHEET: Per-km bus contracts with state transport undertakings (STUs)

**How to read this**
- The rate depends on who pays for fuel, driver, conductor and charging. Never compare rates without checking that first.
- Several figures are tender "worked examples" or study assumptions, not actual winning rates. I label these.
- I found no source for an operator's actual net profit per bus or break-even time under any STU contract. Please don't state one on screen. See "Gaps" at the end.

---

**1. The 3 contract types (use as on-screen labels)**

- Gross Cost Contract (GCC): the operator supplies the bus, the driver and the maintenance, the authority pays a fixed rate per kilometre operated, and the fare box belongs to the authority. [https://yomobility.com/blog/electric-bus-fleet-operations/]
- Wet lease, diesel (RSRTC style): the operator brings a new bus with a driver. RSRTC's own conductor runs the bus. RSRTC pays a decided net rate per km, and the bus is run through its conductor. [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2022/2023/Tende.pdf]
- Punjab "Kilometre Scheme": a private operator buys a bus and leases it to the Transport Department. The government bears the cost of fuel and the conductor's salary. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/punjab/punjab-roadways-prtc-employees-protest-brings-focus-on-kilometre-scheme/]

---

**2. How the tender works (RSRTC, Rajasthan, 2024–26 documents)**

- Bidders quote a rate per bus per km. The rate for hiring is quoted in the BOQ per km per bus. [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2022/2023/Tende.pdf]
- It is a two-bid process. The technical part is evaluated against eligibility criteria, and qualified bidders then get their financial bids opened. [https://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/June2019/1142_280519.pdf]
- Bid security goes to the Financial Adviser, RSRTC, as a demand draft or an irrevocable bank guarantee. The bank guarantee is valid for one year from the last bid date. [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2025/TenderDocs.pdf]
- Bid security amounts in 2025-26 notices (the document wording is unclear on whether each is per bus or per lot, so verify before quoting):
  - AC 2x2 deluxe diesel: ₹3,29,000 [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2025/2x2AC.pdf]
  - AC 2x1 sleeper: ₹3,46,000 [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2025/2x1AC.pdf]
  - AC 3x2 electric, 12 m, without infrastructure: ₹3,10,000 [https://transport.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/transport/RSRTC/pdf/Tenders/2025/Tende_176.pdf]
- Older RSRTC Star Line bid (2023-24): EMD of ₹50,000
